question: CYBS is related to GWFQ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, KUJO is related to OSNM. To which of the following options is SQRK related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

CYBS is related to GWFQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b97cf7863f39a89c5ba03dc5eaa08004a3d516a08b0cf86d47af72ff995c66b3.png] 

KUJO is related to OSNM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b87987433d8b8c8b1e5f7fae4010ed8b5f8622ec809374fe457fb01b665cf8ef.png] 

Similarly, SQRK will be related,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52b087a9ca6a143a1f104a7dab0eb5e3adb230976156f6fbc127e66f76552fe8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**WOVI**".
